what_it_does: This paper accelerates the computation of eigenvalue decomposition (EVD), a fundamental linear algebra operation that breaks down matrices into eigenvectors and eigenvalues. The research focuses on the back transformation step, which converts intermediate results from a bulge-chasing algorithm into final eigenvectors. On graphics processors (GPUs), this step previously lost performance because it was structured inefficiently. The paper replaces level-3 math operations (matrix-matrix multiplication) with level-2 operations (matrix-vector multiplication) and reorders the computation sequence to hide latency and improve parallelism.
